items.text: I just had my 2 week follow up with my audiologist. They shortened the wire on my right ear (I think maybe a little too short, dang it) and replaced the open domes with a closed dome that looks kinda flat maybe a tulip but didn't look like the one on the resound website. She said shes gotten a lot of positive feedback back on them and thinks they might be more helpful for my tinnitus. She calibrated the aids to make up for closed domes. And I think they are working! Last night my left ear had no ringing. It's not permanent, as I took mine out to wash my car and the ringing is now super loud. But after having them in all day yesterday the ringing was minimal. Just an fyi if people are still struggling with tinnitus.
